decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a combo using goblins to generate mana and sacrifice creatures for value. Dark-Dweller Oracle and Skirk Prospector are used to sacrifice creatures like Putrid Goblin, while Unearth and Deadly Dispute can bring back key creatures. First Day of Class helps to find combo pieces, while Makeshift Munitions can deal damage using sacrificed artifacts. Drossforge Bridge and Ichor Wellspring provide card advantage, while Kuldotha Rebirth creates token goblins. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient combo strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up strong, evasive creatures by enchanting them with auras. By utilizing the hexproof ability of creatures like Gladecover Scout and Slippery Bogle, the deck aims to protect them from removal spells and build them up with powerful auras like Ancestral Mask and Ethereal Armor. The inclusion of cards like Armadillo Cloak and Lifelink helps to give the creatures additional resilience and staying power in order to close out the game quickly with aggressive attacks.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with fast and efficient creatures like Festival Crasher, Kiln Fiend, and Monastery Swiftspear. By utilizing cards like Ancestral Anger, Crash Through, and Temur Battle Rage, the deck aims to deal damage swiftly and efficiently. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast to finish off opponents or clear the way for attackers. By utilizing pump spells like Mutagenic Growth and Apostle's Blessing, this deck aims to deliver a quick and lethal blow to the opponent in a Pauper 1 vs 1 matchup.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards that provide value over time, such as Archaeomancer and Mulldrifter. By combining these cards with instant speed removal and countermagic, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind them out of resources. The inclusion of Ephemerate allows for even more value by blinking key creatures and spells for additional effects. The deck also utilizes bounce lands and card draw to ensure consistent mana production and hand refills.

This deck focuses on quickly bringing out efficient and cheap artifact creatures to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and resource denial. By sacrificing artifacts to trigger effects and generate card advantage, the deck aims to maintain a constant flow of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. With a mix of powerful creatures, removal spells, and card draw, the deck seeks to apply pressure and quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up damage through low-cost creatures and spells, with the goal of overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. By utilizing cards like Kiln Fiend and Monastery Swiftspear alongside pump spells like Mutagenic Growth and Temur Battle Rage, the deck aims to deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time. The inclusion of cards like Faithless Looting and Manamorphose helps to maintain card advantage and enable explosive plays.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence by playing low-cost creatures and utilizing cards like Faithless Looting and Thrilling Discovery to draw into more threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and combat tricks like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Strands to maintain control of the battlefield. By utilizing cards like Squadron Hawk and Battle Screech, the deck can generate a steady stream of creatures to apply pressure while also having access to reach with Rally the Peasants. Finally, the inclusion of Springleaf Drum helps to accelerate the deck's mana production.

The UR Control pauper deck aims to control the game by using a combination of counter spells, removal, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own win conditions. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in longer games. The deck utilizes efficient creatures like Augur of Bolas and Ninja of the Deep Hours alongside burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Skred to maintain board control and pressure opponents. Additionally, the inclusion of Faerie Seer and Spellstutter Sprite provides additional card selection and disruption options for the deck.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, using low-cost creatures like Burning Prophet, Festival Crasher, Kiln Fiend, and Monastery Swiftspear to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Spells like Crash Through, Reckless Impulse, Apostle's Blessing, Lava Dart, Manamorphose, Mutagenic Growth, and Temur Battle Rage help to pump up the creatures and push through any blockers. With a mana base of 18 Mountains, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to set up their defenses.

The focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the board using cheap creatures and countermagic, while also efficiently drawing and filtering through the deck to maintain card advantage. The deck utilizes cheap and evasive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Faeries to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their plays with counterspells like Counterspell and Spellstutter Sprite. The inclusion of cards like Of One Mind and Preordain help ensure card advantage and consistency in the deck's strategy. The overall goal is to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to stall the game using a combination of fog effects and card draw while searching for key combo pieces. Using cards like Moment's Peace and Weather the Storm to prevent damage, and Behold the Multiverse and Arcane Denial to draw cards and find necessary combo pieces, this deck aims to control the game until it can assemble its win condition. With the potential to generate large amounts of mana and draw through the deck quickly, this deck can overwhelm opponents with its combo finish.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain a low mana curve and put pressure on the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Seeker of the Way. The deck also utilizes artifact cards like Ichor Wellspring and Experimental Synthesizer to generate card advantage and deal additional damage with cards like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt. The mana base includes cards like Boros Garrison and Ancient Den to help fix mana and ensure a smooth curve of aggressive plays.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence with low-cost, evasive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Faerie Miscreant, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Spellstutter Sprite and Counterspell. By utilizing efficient card draw spells like Of One Mind, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and keep up the pressure on the opponent. With the ability to protect its creatures and counter key spells, Mono Blue Aggro is designed to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through tempo advantage.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Festival Crasher, Kiln Fiend, and Monastery Swiftspear, supported by spells like Ancestral Anger, Crash Through, and Faithless Looting to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Cards like Lava Dart, Mutagenic Growth, and Temur Battle Rage provide additional ways to pump up the creatures and push damage through. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and burn spells to win the game quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to use counter spells and removal to control the board while using card selection and draw spells to manipulate the opponent's hand and deck. The deck also incorporates creatures with disruptive abilities to further control the game. The mana base includes a mix of snow-covered lands and utility lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors for spells. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and out-value them with efficient card advantage and removal options.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Voldaren Epicure alongside burn spells like Chain Lightning, Lava Spike, and Lightning Bolt, the goal is to deal damage quickly and efficiently. With cards like Skewer the Critics, Fireblast, and Searing Blaze providing additional damage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.
